The voice enabled chatbot has been implemented as a Node.js application backed by a retrieval-based model. The dataset containing information on Indian monuments in a QA format was fed to the system to build intents and answer user queries. The proposed approach attempts to deliver an end-to-end system for tourists, foreign as well as domestic, visiting various monuments. The research process also led to the creation of an unavailable dataset covering almost all monuments of India.

articleTitle: Enchancing Crop Productivity through Early Plant Disease Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: As the agricultural nation, India's GDP is mostly derived from agriculture (about 64%), with other industries following. Our economy's foundation is agriculture. As such, the primary source of revenue is agricultural. Unfortunately, agricultural productivity has declined along with production due to a number of issues including pests, diseases, and climate change. There is uncertainty around the management of plant diseases, thus accurate diagnosis is crucial. Plant disease knowledge, a great deal of work, and a lot of study time are all necessary. Consequently, by obtaining complete images and contrasting them with archived data, imaging techniques are utilized to diagnose plant illnesses. There are numerous image-formatted pages in this document The goal of this project is to develop an independent application that will offer the essential disease-related data. The project's goal is to support and assist monoculture farmers. In this study, we suggest a way to watch and diagnose plant diseases using several imaging techniques. Application results demonstrate the proposed system's ability to successfully identify and categorize plant diseases. Three main plant disease kinds are discussed in this article: Tomato, Grapes and Apples.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction Using ARIMA: A Study on AAPL, MSFT, NFLX, and GOOGL Stocks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: It is widely acknowledged that being able to predict stock prices with accuracy remains the crux of classical financial statements, and has a multipurpose function including benefits for individual investors, portfolio managers, and policymakers. This paper explores the efficacy of the Autoregressive Moving Average (ARMA) model in predicting the stock prices of four leading technology companies: For example, Apple Inc. (AAPL), Microsoft Corp. (MSFT), Netflix Inc. (NFLX), and Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL). Using the original daily stock prices from January 2010 to December 2023, this study is going to trace out the good and bad of applying the ARMA model. Research utilizes a systematic approach to data preprocessing that makes stationarity features available and makes optimal lag selection based on the Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) and the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) possible. The performance of the ARMA model is rigorously analyzed using three primary metrics: Mean absolute errors (MAE), Root mean square Error (RMSE), and Mean absolute percentage error (MAPE). The results value stands out in that the ARMA model can achieve good accuracy, with the MAPE values ranging from 1.10% to 1.50%. In such a manner, as half the cases were correct, the method can be considered a reliable forecasting instrument. It should be added that comparative study with more complicated models, such as ARIMA, LSTM, and GARCH models, gives the ARMA model a competitive advantage, primarily in terms of the simplicity of its code and the shortness of its execution time. The study puts ARMA models in a strong proactive position and ends with ARMA model further research into the hybrid model that combines ARMA with advanced machine learning techniques aimed at improving predictive accuracy.

articleTitle: Crop Yield Prediction using Remote Sensing: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Crop yield prediction is a crucial need in agriculture, offering valuable insights for the farmers, agriculturists, and policy makers. The statistical models utilized for this purpose were time-consuming, difficult, and challenging. However, the emergence of machine learning and deep learning models has revolutionized this field. The integration of remote sensing data in crop yield prediction provides essential information for large-scale crop modeling. This review article delves into the advancement of crop models, remote sensing techniques and data assimilation methods that monitor crop growth and enhance crop yield prediction.

articleTitle: Taxonomy of Diverse Soft Computing Techniques for Various Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Soft computing techniques have made significant contributions to modern life by solving a broad category of problems with effective answers. Even though optimization problems can be extremely complicated, they are typically dealt with and solved by combining the practitioner's many abilitiess, like instinctive behavior, prior knowledge, logical reasoning, mathematical elaboration, and physical sensation. When applied within the "soft computing" paradigm, heuristics theories and algorithms can offer a methodical and reasonable means of addressing optimization issues. In this work, we offer A comprehensive description of the most recent soft computing applications in a variety of fields. To address various societal issues and their existing solutions, a comprehensive overview of various methods for soft computing, such as neural networks, swarm intelligence, evolutionary computing, fuzzy computing, and their hybrid combinations, is presented.

articleTitle: Enhancing E-Commerce Engagement: Exploring AR and VR-Based Marketing Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: In the field ofae-commerce, augmented reality (AR)aand virtual reality (VR) technologies have drawn a lot of attention since they provide cutting-edge methods to improve online purchasing and increase customer interaction. This study offers a thorough analysis of the body of research on augmented reality and virtual reality-based e-commerce marketing tactics. The paper examines how AR and VR technologies have evolved in the setting of e-commerce and how they might affect marketing strategies through a combination of methodological approaches, theoretical frameworks, and research findings. The use of AR and VR in product visualization, virtual try-on experiences, interactive ads, and immersive shopping environments are some of the key subjects explored. The methodology section covers the range of research methods used to examine marketing strategies based on AR and VR, including bibliometric analysis, simulations, and experimental studies. The study tackles research gaps and obstacles, such as user adoption barriers, ethical considerations, and the need for empirical validation of marketing efficacy, while also underlining the tremendous opportunities presented by AR and VR technology. The section that concludes highlights potential avenues for future study as well as practical applications for e-commerce companies wishing to use AR and VR to improve customer experiences and gain a competitive edge.

articleTitle: Integrating NLP with Random Forest for Emotion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: NLP enables computers to understand and process human language. It has become an integral technology for machine translation, spam detection, and medical applications. This section could outline key NLP methods like syntax analysis, semantic analysis, and statistical NLP. It could also describe evolutionary and revolutionary changes in NLP techniques over time. The performance of the proposed method - Random Forest, is estimated by utilizing the Emotion data consisting of various human emotions expressed as comments. The proposed method has acquired an accuracy of 95.08% as compared to the other existing techniques. Recent advances like neural networks and deep learning enable more nuanced NLP applications. This section could highlight new techniques and future directions like conversational AI and multilingual NLP. Despite progress, NLP still faces challenges in understanding context, sarcasm, dialects, etc. This section could summarize existing weaknesses and difficulties like bias in training data. In conclusion, NLP has become a versatile technology, evolving from rule-based to statistical to neural techniques. Applications will continue to expand as methods improve in accuracy and flexibility. However, challenges remain in reaching human-level language understanding.

articleTitle: MultiPhased Technique for Enhancing Security in Data Center Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: In the present scenario, Secured data transmission is crucial for effective communication. Data integrity and security must be maintained during transfer. Encryption will be used for data transfer. In the first phase, image steganography technique is used to hide the data inside the image. Then, the image is converted into an encrypted format using various symmetric key algorithms. After encryption, the use of AES will be implemented. AES has been adopted by the U.S. government and is now used worldwide. It supersedes the Data Encryption Standard. Data hiding is the secret form of sending data. It involves hiding data so that it is not noticeable. This includes steganography and watermarking. Steganography is the science of communicating secret data in multimedia files like images, audio, or videos. Encryption transforms information into a code and helps maintain data security. This project will explore data hiding techniques using images as carriers, as well as encryption and decryption for security. This project focuses on privacy as data security is crucial in today’s world. It is important to transfer data from one place to another. This data may be in the form of text, image, audio, or video.

articleTitle: An Effective Stage of Preprocessing Design for Identifying Mango Leaf Disease via Hybrid Filtration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Mango, a vital fruit crop cultivated across various regions globally, faces health and productivity challenges due to several diseases. Among the prevalent diseases are black sooty mold, bacterial canker, and anthracnose, which are distinguished by leaf lesions. Employing methods for processing images offers a means to identify and categorize anthracnose signs on mango leaves. This study introduces a procedure to enhance Mango leaf illustration quality for more effective processing. The approach encompasses preparing pictures for processing by reducing noise and sharpening, followed by segmentation using the thresholding of Otsu. The suggested approach underwent testing on a dataset of mango leaf images, exhibiting improved quality metrics such as PSNR and MSE. The findings underscore the possibility of employing these methods of processing for early disease identification and control of mango trees, ultimately enhancing the yield and quality of crops.

articleTitle: Translation English to Punjabi: A Concise Review of Significant Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Over the years, Machine Translation in English to Punjabi has seen significant advancements. The study emphasizes Punjabi’s unique linguistic complexities, which pose challenges for accurate and contextually relevant translations. Recognizing the importance of overcoming these obstacles, the paper investigates various pre-processing methodologies within neural-based and statistical-based Machine Translation systems. It examines the methods to improve translation accuracy, addressing issues such as morphological complexity, syntactic variations, and a lack of parallel corpora. Effective pre-processing techniques are highlighted as a critical step toward improving machine translation performance for Punjabi. Ultimately, by capitalizing on existing advancements, this study highlights practical implications and potential areas for improvement, focusing on the end-user experience.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Stress Analysis and Management: A Novel Approach Leveraging OpenAI and NoSQL Databases to Empower Students in Stress Management and Promote Overall Student Well-being and Academic Progression
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Now a days, students are under a lot of stress due to social issues and schoolwork. Additionally, they use smart devices excessively, which negatively impacts their mental health. an online application that allows users to actively interact with the system to get recommendations and insights specific to their level of stress. This ground-breaking fusion establishes the foundation for an approachable and proactive stress-reduction solution. This project aims to produce a novel stress analysis tool by integrating NoSQL databases with OpenAI's superior natural language processing, specifically the GPT-3.5 model. Real-time stress analysis is made possible by the system's ability to collect extensive stress-related data from users by utilizing OpenAI's superior language understanding skills. Scalability is enhanced by the incorporation of NoSQL databases, which guarantee effective unstructured data retrieval and storage.

articleTitle: CodeXchange: Leaping into the Future of AI-Powered Code Editing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: In the ever-changing internet ecosystem, where programs need to be regularly updated by users themselves not saving time and space, web-based coding tools surpass conventional desktop programs. Thus, showing online code editors enabling programmers to interact, experiment, and innovate efficiently. This study centers on "CodeXchange," an innovative online code editor designed to streamline coding processes and foster collaboration. It discusses the capabilities of code translation in Python, Java, and C++, optimization, auto-commenting, and collaborative development. Translation aids in code interchange, optimization ideas enhance time complexity and maintainability, while direct code comments improve documentation and comprehension. Multiple developers can interact on the same codebase using websockets and secure shared room access keys, enabling real-time collaborative coding and fostering knowledge exchange and cooperation. This study showcases the significant development of online code editors and their potential to revolutionize how programmers communicate, develop, and learn.

articleTitle: Malware Detection in IoT Devices Using Machine Learning: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: A thorough summary of recent studies on malware detection in Internet of Things environments can be found in the literature review section. The necessity for complex and scalable detection techniques is emphasized by examining various approaches, from signature-based to anomaly detection approaches. Furthermore, the discussion comprises the application of supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised machine learning algorithms to mitigate IoT malware threats. While unsupervised techniques like clustering algorithms show promise in detecting new threats, supervised learning techniques like support vector machines (SVM) and random forests (RF) effectively identify known malware patterns. Furthermore, semi-supervised learning techniques present a viable way to improve detection abilities by utilizing compactly labeled data.

articleTitle: Survey of Cloud Computing with Role of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Cloud computing is the biggest buzz in the computer world these days. Cloud computing means different things to different people. In this paper, we have discussed the basic concepts of Cloud computing includes Cloud computing characteristics, models, resource management phases, challenges. This paper also presents a comprehensive mapping study aimed at understanding the themes and trends of machine learning with Cloud computing. Machine learning is heavily utilized in Cloud computing, Cloud data centre performance may be enhanced and resource management become more effective by merging machine learning with Cloud computing methods. In general, Cloud computing has benefited greatly from machine learning, which has improved performance, security, and resource management among other areas.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis for Short and Long-Term Time Series for Energy Consumption Predictions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: A substantial portion of the Sustainable Development Goals rely on energy. Ensuring the availability of reliable, contemporary, and inexpensive energy to humanity is the specified goal of SDG Goal 7. The rapid expansion of high-density cities as accompanied by commercial and industrial development leads to an increase in consumption of energy, especially in the form of electricity. So, concerning reducing the energy footprint energy prediction is an important concern to enhance energy management strategies for buildings. With the goal of fulfilling future energy requirements, this paper provides an extensive literature evaluation of forecasting techniques utilized by researchers for usage of energy in smart buildings. Research continues to be done on various forecasting techniques for both residential and non-residential buildings. Based on the dataset, various load categories, accuracy of prediction, and evaluation criteria used, the research literature is further examined. Some of the challenges like load fluctuation, missing data, occupant electricity usage behaviour are discussed. To reduce the negative impact of high energy consumption, there is a need to implement energy-efficient technologies and practices in buildings and industries. While the implementation of smart meters has set up opportunities with the objective to anticipate power through sensors and energy monitoring, machine learning approaches are currently unable to analyze data with respect to their chronological dimensionality.As a consequence, time constraints are considered and recurrent neural networks, sequence-to-sequence deep learning algorithms, long short-term memory, convolutional neural networks, and hybrid machine learning approaches are implemented to develop forecasting load proximity. The techniques will be used to handle missing data like mean value imputation, Last observation carried forward, etc. to handle missing data as otherwise, it would lead to biased estimation. This paper provides an overview of energy consumption forecasting within smart buildings aimed at enhancing energy efficiency. It examines current research directions employing various forecasting algorithms and introduces a novel methodology for predicting energy consumption.

articleTitle: Classification of Electroencephalography Bio Signals Based on Motor Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Stroke is known to be a cause of multitude impairments, including abnormalities in physical, motor, and emotional capabilities in stroke patients. Studies have demonstrated that employing motor imagery tasks through Electroencephalogram (EEG) bio signals yields 10% higher accuracy compared to conventional Electroencephalogram (EEG) methods. Thus, the primary goal of this study is to employ machine learning algorithms to classify Electroencephalogram (EEG) bio signals based on motor imagery from healthy people and stroke patient’s open-source datasets. Methods such as Custom Spatial Filter (CSP) is used to extract pertinent features from the acquired data after thorough processing and filtering. It was found that SVM has yielded up to 98.86% of accuracy in classifying motor imagery tasks compared to Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), and Gaussian Naïve Bayes (GNB) algorithms.

articleTitle: Optimizing Handwritten Digit Recognition with CNN and Data Augmentation Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Convolutional Neural networks (CNN) are very effective in recognizing handwritten digits/ words by extracting distinct features from images and are more suitable to solve handwriting recognition problems. This paper presents an experimental investigation and testing of an improved CNN technique for recognizing handwritten digits and solve the computation problem with higher accuracy. We propose a deep learning framework focused on refining CNN concepts, aiming for precise identification and evaluation of user-provided handwritten mathematical images. Our objective is to achieve absolute accuracy and efficiency. We choose the Convolutional Neural Network for its computational efficiency and potential for improved accuracy over existing models. We introduce a method that outperforms current models in terms of computational cost, speed, and accuracy while prioritizing user accessibility and ease of computation. The key enhancement lies in the use of an improved CNN, which simplifies user access and computation compared to traditional CNN or Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) approaches.

articleTitle: Potential of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is gaining attention in multidisciplinary area such as business, management, decision sciences, and healthcare sector. Nowadays AI is receiving more attention in health care sectors including diagnosis, patient data, and decision-making regarding treatment. This review article is based on the contribution of AI in healthcare and mainly focuses on AI in diagnosis, genomics, drug discovery and patient care. Along with the role of AI in health maintenance, it explains the various challenges faced in using AI in healthcare and disadvantages associate with its use.

articleTitle: Utilizing Fuzzy Logic in MATLAB for Visualizing Risk Factors associated with Cardiovascular Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Data mining techniques are commonly used into clinical decision support systems to gather and diagnose various medical conditions accurately. Clinical decision support systems play an important role in cardiovascular disease diagnosis, showing their crucial role in recognizing significant death rates associated with heart disease globally. Heart disease prediction systems primarily use clinical datasets from lab analyses, but often overlook crucial factors like age, family history, diabetes, hypertension, hypercholesterolemia, nicotine/liquor use, obesity, or sedentary lifestyle. A system built upon these risk factors serves as a valuable tool for healthcare professionals, offering proactive indications of potential heart disease to patients. This proactive approach has reduced the need for hospital visits or expensive medical checkups. As a result, the current research presents a way for predicting heart disease by leveraging significant risk factors. This approach utilizes the highly effective fuzzy decision support system, a prominent tool in data mining, for enhancing risk stratification processes. The system uses patient age, blood pressure, blood cholesterol levels, and physical activity as input parameters to generate a single output giving the status of risk. This risk status is segmented into categories of varying severity, including "Not serious," "Serious," and "Very serious," facilitating determine risk assessment and stratification.

articleTitle: Elegant Techniques and Methods for Blockchain-Powered Electronic Voting Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: The integration of the blockchain technology into electronic voting systems is an innovation that has gained popularity due to the issues prevailing with the conventional voting methods. The purpose of the work is to provide a thorough explanation of the design and execution of the blockchain-based electronic voting system, emphasizing the system’s significance in revolutionizing global electoral procedures. This study explores various blockchain consensus mechanisms such as Proof of Work (PoW), Proof of Stake (PoS), and Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance (PBFT), analyzing their relevance in e-voting systems. Additionally, the paper investigates challenges related to scalability, interoperability, and regulatory compliance, proposing innovative solutions to address these complexities.

articleTitle: Role of AI in Enhancing Health Insurance Penetration in Rural India
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Despite significant advancements in healthcare infrastructure, rural India faces challenges in obtaining and using health insurance services. Limited accessibility, financial constraints, and lack of information are major barriers to health insurance penetration. Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies can personalize health insurance offers, adjust them to rural communities' unique needs, and optimize pricing models for affordability. Machine learning algorithms and predictive analytics can be used to personalize insurance, while chatbots and virtual assistants can raise awareness and streamline enrollment processes. This study examines the impact of AI on expanding health insurance coverage in rural areas, considering the evolving healthcare landscape in India. AI can make insurance more accessible, affordable, and tailored to rural populations. It can also contribute to more precise risk assessment and better claims processing. The integration of mobile technology and digital platforms is crucial for bridging the digital gap and ensuring universal accessibility.

articleTitle: National Telecom Volunteer: Utilizing A Machine Learning Model To Predict Cellphone Network Coverage Using Big Data Analysis From Data Collected Through Crowdsourcing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: In India remarkable developments have been taking place in the field of 5G technology and associated use cases after the launch of 5G in Oct 2022. However, no tool is available for real-time monitoring of the presence of telecom technology (2G/3G/4G/5G) and QoS (Quality of Service) within a region or to an individual. Thus, this paper proposes a methodology and related tools to measure ground-level QoS, results of which can be utilised by DoT (Department of Telecommunications), Government of India for taking proactive steps to provide high-quality telecom coverage to all citizens, focusing on strategic areas achieving the goals of the National Digital Communication Policy 2018. To achieve this, a smartphone app was developed to collect data from citizens who can share their locations and cell phone signal data as volunteers. Considering the country's population of almost ~1.4 billion, a 1% volunteer rate would generate significant data for the server. A highly available server architecture design has been proposed to handle this massive data. Mobile BTS (Base Transceiver Station), topographical and meteorological data from the government will be used along with collected signal data. Machine learning will forecast data for the missing locations since there will be few nationwide volunteers.

articleTitle: A Critical Analysis for Detection of Parkinson’s Disease Based on Voice Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a neurological condition that results in a variety of motor and non-motor symptoms. It is caused due to degeneration of nerve cells in the central nervous system. The motor symptoms include posture instability, gait disorder, bradykinesia and tremors etc. while non-motor symptoms are related to dysphonia, sleep disorder etc. PD is an incurable disease at present. Therefore, an early detection and treatment is required to improve life conditions and is motivation for the research. Various research analyzed motor symptoms to detect PD. However, motor symptoms become visible in late stages. Speech impairment is a symptom which is visible in early stages of PD and therefore remains an open area for research. The state-of-art has utilized various Machine Learning (ML), Deep Learning (DL) and Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) techniques to detect PD in patients. This paper presents a rigorous study of works done between 2018-2023. 14 papers based on detection of PD have been chosen and an analysis of their methodology, limitations and results has been done. Various DL models outperformed the ML models in terms of accuracy but do have certain limitations including imbalanced and noisy datasets and the model’s interpretability. The paper also tries to explore the possibilities of implementation of GAN to improve dataset and proposes a model for PD classification which achieved an accuracy of 94.06. In summary, this study aims to provide an overview of research conducted in the field of speech signal-based PD detection and provides a valuable insight for future research aimed at improving PD detection methods.

articleTitle: TriMod Fusion for Multi-Modal Lung Tumor Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Lung cancer (LC) currently has the highest mortality rate of any medical diagnosis, underscoring the urgent need for improved detection techniques. This study highlights the critical role of automated image processing methods in improving the efficiency and accuracy of LC detection and identifies future directions for the field. The authors propose a unique method called TriMod Fusion to assist in uncovering the importance of correct tumor classification for effective patient care and management. This technique enables a more reliable and accurate classification and diagnosis of LC. A thorough examination of LIDC image data shows that the new method surpasses traditional single-modality approaches, improving the classification and diagnosis of lung tumors with higher accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. The study presents a structural framework consisting of five sequential processes to automate the LC image recognition and classification process. Bilateral unsharp masking methods, including Gaussian, median, and adaptive, are used to improve image quality after initial image acquisition. The final stage of classification involves combining multiple neural classifiers with a hierarchical random walker and a Bayesian model. It also uses powerful segmentation algorithms and extraction methods. Findings from the third technique, which utilizes a deep recurrent neural network (DRNN) for categorization, reveal that the diagnostic precision for LC ranges from 87.5% to 97.4%, demonstrating a noteworthy enhancement in diagnostic efficiency.

articleTitle: YTBlend: YouTube Video Recommendations System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: In the dynamic era of online education, the pursuit of a personalized and effective learning experience is paramount. In this research, a sophisticated smart system for learning video recommendations is proposed at the intersection of multimodal data mining and data synthesis in online education. The approach aims to enhance personalized and effective learning experiences by transcending the limitations of traditional recommendation systems. Innovative data synthesis techniques are employed to expand the dataset and improve the adaptability of the system, integrating diverse data sources including text, images, and videos. The methodology involves a comprehensive analysis of learning materials using cutting-edge technologies like natural language processing, computer vision, and video content analysis to deepen the understanding of learner-content interactions. Furthermore, the challenge of hashtag recommendation in short videos is addressed by leveraging their multimodal nature, combining sentiment and content features from image, audio, and text modalities to enhance the accuracy and rationality of hashtag recommendations. This research contributes to redefining the landscape of intelligent learning video recommendations, offering a dynamic platform designed to continuously adapt to the evolving needs and preferences of learners.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Visual Error Detection System (VEDS) Leveraging Convolutional Neural Networks for Early Detection of Ocular Abnormalities to Mitigate Vision-Related Complications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Ocular disorders are one of the severe eye disease The proposed system is to design and develop an automated system which captures the patient's eye image and uses the benefits of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to predict whether the patient suffers from ocular eye disorders or not. The functionality integrates MongoDB database administration with a visual error detection system. The model is employed in a web-based platform that enhances the usefulness of MongoDB overall by utilizing convolutional neural networks (CNN) to interface with it smoothly. The CNN was selected based on its accuracy and trained on several datasets that included around 5000 photos for each category of eye illness from reputable databases including Eye Recognition, IDRiD, and HRF. Instant eye deployment is possible with the user-friendly website while retinal pictures load. Integration with MongoDB enhances user experience, saves and retrieves diagnostic data, and manages data better. Numerous outcomes supported the model's efficacy and indicated a significant advancement in the early diagnosis and treatment of ocular disorders.

articleTitle: Predicting Landslides with Machine Learning: A Data-Driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Routs are usual tragedies that can cause significant damage to the environment and pose a serious danger to humanoid lives and infrastructure. Early detection and identification of potential landslide-prone areas are crucial for disaster mitigation and preparedness efforts. This abstract out-lines a comprehensive approach to landslide identification utilizing machine learning techniques. In recent years, machine learning has emerged as a powerful tool for analyzing geospatial data and predicting geological hazards such as landslides. This research leverages a diverse range of data sources, including remote sensing imagery, topographical maps, rainfall records, and geological data, to develop a robust landslide identification model. The key components of the proposed methodology involve data preprocessing, feature engineering, and the application of various machine learning algorithms. Remote sensing data, such as satellite imagery and LiDAR data, are used to extract valuable terrain features and land cover information. Rainfall data are incorporated to assess the influence of precipitation on landslide occurrence. Geological data contribute to the understanding of local geological conditions. Several machines learning algorithms, including but not limited to decision trees, support vector machines, and neural networks, are employed to create predictive models. These models are trained on historical landslide data and validated against real-world cases. Cross-validation techniques are applied to ensure the model’s robustness and generalization capabilities.

articleTitle: Adversarial Threats in Machine Learning: A Critical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: The fast advancement of machine learning (ML) techniques has brought about both innovative opportunities and unprecedented security challenges. In this paper, we consider the some important field of machine learning conduct a critical survey and analysis of machine language security and its importance, attacks and threats, aiming to provide a comprehensive understanding of the evolving landscape in cybersecurity. We begin by elucidating the fundamental concepts and terminologies associated with ML attacks, laying the groundwork for an in-depth exploration. Subsequently, we categorize and dissect various types of ML attacks, including adversarial attacks, data poisoning, model inversion, and membership inference, among others. Real-world case studies and examples across different domains, such as computer vision and natural language processing, are scrutinized to reveal the intricacies and implications of these attacks. Furthermore, we evaluate existing defense mechanisms and countermeasures, assessing their effectiveness against different attack scenarios. Finally, we discuss the broader societal impacts and ethical considerations surrounding the deployment of ML technologies in security-critical applications. this paper provides the tools to handle the machine language’s attacks and their solution using integration of academic research with real world examples.

articleTitle: Innovative Deep Learning Methods for Soil Classification and Crop Yield Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: The significance of soil in sustaining life on Earth cannot be overstated, particularly its role in crop production and environmental sustainability. This paper presents a analysis of various machine-learning models employed in soil classification and their implications for crop productivity. Soil texture and nutrient composition are pivotal factors influencing crop growth and sustainability. Leveraging machine learning techniques, such as classification algorithms and computer vision, this study evaluates the effectiveness of Decision Trees (DT), k nearest Neighbors (k-NN), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), and Support Vector Machines (SVM) in automating the soil classification process. These models utilize detectable features including Soil characteristics like moisture, nutrients, structure, quality, pH, and texture to classify soil types accurately. Additionally, techniques like interpolation of soil particle size fractions using transformed data are explored. By examining the performance and efficiency of these models, this research aims to contribute insights into optimizing soil management practices for enhanced crop production and environmental sustainability.

articleTitle: Intelligent Crop Selection and Soil Nutrient Management Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Machine learning employs a wide range of techniques to create models that can foresee yet-to-be-seen data in the future and derive prediction rules from known data, with the use of the same we generate a system that is being suggested to combine information from the meteorological service, grain depository, and soil data to anticipate the most suited crops based on the present state of the environment. The choice of the appropriate crop for the farm’s soil conditions is one of the most crucial factors in agriculture. To aid these farmers, a Python prototype of a real-time crop recommendation programme that combines machine learning and data analytics was developed. The ability for computers to learn and adapt without explicit programming is provided by the field of machine learning, falls under the category of artificial intelligence (AI). Traditional disease detection and nutrient value estimation methods are being replaced by a new, more advanced approach that takes advantage of dataset upgrades and looks at the patterns different crops create in response to different climatic conditions. We are collecting data that includes values for the following elements: Nitrogen (N), Potassium (K), Phosphorous (P), Iron (Fe), Zinc (Zn), Copper (Cu), Manganese (Mn), Boron (B), and Sulphur (S) pH, temperature, humidity, rainfall, with the label of crop type for the various districts. High crop yields and the production of high-quality goods depend on the availability of soil nutrients. Therefore, the primary goal of this paper is to provide farmers with a remedy since they frequently administer fertilizer at random without realizing its poor quality or quantity. In order to produce new features, extract them, scale them for the specific ML model, and choose the best one, we provide and place our systematic dataset under numerous machine learning models. In light of this, automatic identification and monitoring are crucial for ensuring sustained agricultural income.

articleTitle: Dehazing Algorithms for Improved Visibility: Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Dehazing algorithms play a role in enhancing visibility and image quality in situations affected by haze. This research paper delves into dehazing methods conducting a comparison to unveil their complexities and assess their ability to enhance clarity in hazy images. Haze elimination is a step-in computer vision and image manipulation playing a role in various applications such as surveillance and autonomous vehicles. This research systematically examines a range of dehazing techniques considering both conventional and cuttingedge approaches. By evaluating performance metrics for image quality, the goal is to gain an insight into each algorithm. The findings of this study aim to offer insights for researchers, computer vision professionals and industry experts when selecting dehazing methods that align with specific needs and scenarios. The discoveries contribute to the progression of cutting-edge techniques for reducing haze, encouraging innovations that have the potential to enhance the clarity of images in challenging environmental conditions. Eventually, this research aims to bridge the gap between theoretical advancements and practical implementations, fostering progress in dehazing technology applicable across a broad spectrum of applications.

articleTitle: Virtual Drive: Immersive VR-Controlled Car with Real-Time Interaction and Live Video Feed
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: This project investigates the creation and application of a revolutionary virtual drive experience that blends immersive virtual reality (VR) technology with a real-world automotive simulator. The technology promises to deliver an unrivaled driving experience by allowing users to manage a virtual car in real time and view live video feeds from cameras mounted on the real car. Motion controllers, an excellent VR headset with motion tracking, and a customizable driving simulator with haptic feedback are examples of hardware components. The virtual experience is improved by the cameras and sensors in the actual automobile, which capture ambient data and real-time video feeds. Software development includes both realistic virtual reality surroundings and a sophisticated control mechanism that translates human motions into virtual activity. Real-time interaction features and the incorporation of live video streams boost user engagement. Network connectivity ensures smooth interaction and video streaming. Easy-to-use interfaces facilitate information access and control. Several tests and optimizations ensure performance and safety. The deployment process includes continuing adjustments based on user feedback and integration with VR platforms. The process of creating a unique virtual drive experience is described in this paper, along with examples of hardware-software integration that open up new possibilities for VR-controlled applications in the future.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Remote Sensing of Forest Fire Breakouts: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Ecosystems, human lives, and property are all seriously threatened by wildfires, hence effective monitoring and management techniques are required. Hyperspectral remote sensing has emerged as a promising tool for detecting and monitoring forest fire breakouts due to its ability to capture detailed spectral information across a wide range of wavelengths. However, despite its potential, several challenges hinder its widespread application in this domain. Challenges include the complexity of spectral data analysis, limited spatial resolution, and the need for robust algorithms for fire detection and monitoring. Existing works in hyperspectral remote sensing of forest fires have made strides in addressing these challenges but are often limited in scope or lack comprehensive analyses. Thus, there is a pressing need for a systematic review that consolidates existing knowledge, identifies gaps, and proposes avenues for future research. This paper aims to fill this gap by providing a comprehensive review of hyperspectral remote sensing techniques for forest fire breakout detection and monitoring. We discuss the key challenges, methodologies, and findings from previous studies, and highlight areas requiring further investigation. By synthesizing existing literature, this review aims to guide researchers and practitioners towards more effective strategies for forest fire management and mitigation.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Accurate Plant Disease Classification Using ResNet50: A Comprehensive Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: The timely and accurate identification of plant diseases is paramount for minimizing crop losses and guaranteeing food security globally. This study investigates the efficacy of deep learning in classifying plant diseases through the analysis of leaf images. A convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture is proposed, utilizing pre-trained weights from ResNet50 and subsequently fine-tuned on a dataset encompassing 38 distinct plant diseases. Data augmentation techniques are implemented to address class imbalance and bolster model robustness. The constructed model achieves a noteworthy validation accuracy of 96.49%, demonstrating its proficiency in differentiating various plant diseases. This research underscores the potential of deep learning in plant disease detection, paving the way for its real-world application within precision agriculture.

articleTitle: A Review of Conventional Techniques used for Optimized Utilization of Resources in Blockchain Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Blockchain technology is a game-changing technology that can completely overhaul number of domains by proposing decentralized, transparent, and unchangeable transaction ledgers. The purpose of this overview of the literature is to methodically examine previous studies that have attempted to maximize resource usage in blockchain networks. The initial section of the survey explains the basic ideas of blockchain technology as well as the essential hardware requirements, such as processing power, storage, bandwidth, and energy. After that, it investigates other optimization strategies that have been put out in the literature, including resource allocation plans, network protocols, consensus algorithms, and data compression. This literature review offers an in-depth examination of peer-reviewed articles, conference papers, and technical reports, offering valuable perspectives on resource usage optimization inside blockchain networks. It points up areas in need of investigation, obstacles to overcome, and potential paths for academics and business experts.

articleTitle: Enhancing Breast Cancer Diagnosis with Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: The maximum not unusual cancer among women is Breast cancer. Early detection and accurate diagnosis are crucial for improving patient outcomes. Over the years, numerous classification techniques have been developed to aid in the accurate diagnosis of breast cancer. This paper provides a comprehensive review of the existing breast cancer classification techniques, including machine learning, deep learning, and image processing-based approaches. The paper also highlights the advantages and limitations of each technique and identifies areas for future research.

articleTitle: Blockchain-powered Healthcare: Revolutionizing Security and Privacy in IoT-based Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: The rapid growth of the IoT and wearable device industries has expanded remote patient monitoring, but healthcare systems face security vulnerabilities inherent in their client/server architecture. To address these challenges and meet regulatory standards, a shift to a distributed architecture is necessary. Blockchain technology offers promise with its distributed nature and security features. MediSecureNet, proposed in this paper, integrates blockchain and IoT to create a secure healthcare system. Prioritizing security, scalability, and processing speed, MediSecureNet focuses on remote patient monitoring, particularly for chronic conditions. It incorporates a re-encryption proxy for security, blockchain for hash data storage, and smart contracts for access management. Scalability is achieved through an off-chain IPFS database, and an Ethereum-based proof of authority mechanism enhances data storage efficiency.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Energy Consumption Optimization for Smart Homes Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: Energy management in smart homes is one of the many facets of daily living that have been changed by the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT). This study investigates the design and execution of an artificial intelligence (AI) driven system for IoT-enabled smart home energy optimization. This study’s main goal is to provide a framework that uses AI algorithms and Internet of Things sensors to efficiently control and optimize energy use. The system attempts to ensure user comfort and convenience while optimizing energy efficiency through real-time data collecting and analysis. The suggested system’s architecture is covered in the paper. It comprises Internet of Things (IoT) devices placed throughout the smart home to track the energy usage patterns of various appliances and gadgets. Artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, such as machine learning and deep learning models, then evaluate and analyze this data in order to forecast energy demands and optimize usage appropriately. The study also discusses the difficulties in putting such a system into practice, such as interoperability, security, and data privacy concerns. In order to guarantee the smooth integration and functioning of the AI-powered energy optimization system, strategies and solutions for addressing these issues are also put forth. The efficacy and performance of the suggested system are assessed using simulations and real-world trials, showing notable gains in cost and energy efficiency over conventional methods.

articleTitle: Optimizing Cloud Applications with DevOps
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: DevOps methodology helps businesses to create high-quality software by streamlining processes, fostering teamwork, and enhancing productivity throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Research indicates that businesses are struggling with heavy workloads as a result of the rising demand for niche products and technologies. To remain competitive, many of these businesses are using automated technologies and cloud-based solutions. Containerization applications are used to package and distribute code libraries, Git for version control, and cloud computing services to launch cloud-based applications. To speed up various development phases and guarantee a continuous development process, Jenkins is employed as a continuous integration/continuous delivery pipeline. The project methodology was based on DevOps methods, including tools such as Docker for containerization, Git for version control, and Jenkins for continuous integration. This strategy sought to maximize resource use, expedite development processes, and produce high-quality software for cloud-based services. Our results demonstrate that DevOps is a great strategy for deploying cloud apps and selecting resources sensibly, taking into account factors like cost, memory, and CPU capacity. This methodology can also be adapted to meet the requirements of certain applications. The usefulness of DevOps approaches in the deployment of cloud-based apps is highlighted by our findings.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of General Intelligence in relation to Adaptive Intelligence with Impact of Adaptive Learning on Learners
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: The term “general intelligence” describes a broad mental ability that enables people to reason abstractly, solve problems, pick up new knowledge, and adjust to changing circumstances. It is frequently assessed via intelligence tests, such as IQ tests, which evaluate a person’s cognitive skills in a variety of areas, including verbal comprehension, working memory, perceptual reasoning, and processing speed. The ability of a system, like a computer programme or machine, to automatically pick up new information and modify its behaviour in response to interactions with its surroundings is known as adaptive intelligence. It entails utilising a variety of methods, including artificial intelligence and machine learning, to let a system to continuously improve performance and adjust to changing conditions. This may entail modifying methods of problem-solving, communication techniques, or decision-making techniques to better suit the requirements of a particular circumstance. he ability to dynamically alter and improve performance, resulting in more successful outcomes in a variety of circumstances, is the overall characteristic of adaptive intelligence behaviour. The modern online adaptive learning platforms have become exponentially popular among the leaners. It provides the personalized learning experiences for students based on their individual learning requirements and learning patterns. This research explores the general intelligence" and “adaptive intelligence” with their comparative analysis and second phase of research highlights adaptive e-learning benefits as well as the impact of adaptive e-learning on learners’ in online environment.

articleTitle: IoT - Driven Bioelectrical Signals Detection and Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: The integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technology in healthcare has opened new avenues for monitoring and managing patient health remotely. This paper presents the development of innovative bioelectrical signals (Electrocardiography, Electroencephalography, and Electromyography) detection and IoT based monitoring system utilizing ESP32 microcontroller and Bioamp sensor technology. The primary aim of this research is to create a reliable, efficient and user-friendly IoT solution for healthcare, focusing on remote monitoring and analysis of heart, brain and muscle activities. The system architecture comprises a compact wearable Bioamp sensor array capable of capturing ECG, EEG and EMG signals. These signals are processed and transmitted by the ESP32 microcontroller which serves as the central unit for data acquisition, preprocessing and wireless communication. The ESP32 is chosen for its high performance, low power consumption and built-in Wi-Fi capabilities making it ideal for IoT applications. The integration of an Adafruit ILI9341 LCD screen provides real-time visual feedback of the bioelectrical signals and system status to the user. The IoT aspect is realized through the ESP32’s Wi-Fi module which enables the transmission of the processed bioelectrical signal data to a cloud server. This setup allows for remote monitoring and data analysis. This paper discusses the security and privacy concerns associated with transmitting sensitive health data and presents the measures taken to ensure data integrity and confidentiality.

articleTitle: Tokenizing Art Unpacking the Impact of Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) on Ownership Paradigms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: In the realm of the art of ownership, non-fungible Tokens (NFTs) have emerged as a revolutionary technological advancement, challenging conventional ideas of value and authenticity. This comprehensive review critically explores the intersection of NFTs and the art world, delving into their historical evolution, impact on the art market, and implications for artistic expression. By meticulously analyzing existing literature and case studies, this paper illuminates the transformative potential of NFTs, addressing the opportunities and challenges faced by artists, collectors, and stakeholders. The review focuses on key aspects such as legal and copyright considerations, technological constraints, and broader societal and environmental impacts associated with NFTs adoption in the art industry. Through a critical examination of the challenges and limitations of integrating NFTs into the art world, this review identifies areas for innovative solutions and future improvements. It emphasizes the importance of sustainable practice to reduce the environmental impact of NFT transactions and advocates for regularity frameworks to protect artist rights and foster inclusivity. Additionally, the paper underscores the advancements and innovations enabled by NFT adoption, highlighting their role in empowering artists and transforming the dynamics of art ownership and distribution. By suggesting future research directions and opportunities for collaboration, this study contributes to a nuanced understanding of the evolving landscape of art ownership in the digital age.

articleTitle: Exploring EMG Signals for Prosthetic Control and Gesture Recognition: Advancements, Applications, and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: EMG signals and machine learning enable the automation of gesture recognition for addressing challenges faced by amputees in daily life. This review analyses diverse approaches within EMG-based gesture recognition and hand prosthesis control. Shifting muscular intention into natural control offers numerous applications which include helping amputees regain their functioning to completely changing the way we interact with digital surroundings. It highlights advancements in this dynamic field, emphasizing its applications in human-computer interaction, prosthetics and assistive communication. The review focuses on techniques that improve accuracy and robustness which are essential for wider accessibility. Additionally, it explores the potential impact on industries beyond healthcare such as AR/VR, prosthetic hand control, human-machine interaction and sign language recognition. The performance of hybrid approaches and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in gesture recognition tests demonstrates a high degree of accuracy. Overall, EMG-based gesture recognition offers significant promise in driving innovations that enhance quality of life and promote inclusivity. This exploration delves into the recent strides, diverse applications, and future directions of EMG-based prosthetic control and gesture recognition, offering insights into the groundbreaking research shaping this domain.

articleTitle: Knowledge Navigator – Guiding You Through Your Learning Journey Using AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Computing Applications (ICCICA)
abstract: It might be intimidating to navigate the wide array of learning resources in this era of information overload. This article presents Knowledge Navigator, an artificial intelligence (AI) system that adapts the learning process to the needs, preferences, and learning styles of each individual. Knowledge Navigator evaluates past knowledge, determines learning preferences, and comprehends user intent by combining sophisticated Natural Language Processing (NLP) and machine learning algorithms. Users are guaranteed to receive the most interesting and pertinent learning materials, according to their tastes and goals, thanks to this customized approach. The potential advantages of Knowledge Navigator, such as higher learning efficiency, better information retention, and increased student motivation, are discussed in the paper's conclusion. It also looks at potential research avenues in the future, such as gamification and integration with practical uses.
